items.description: One page body or one entry. A page body has kind "page", no entryId and a null trust.

pageId.description: Null for an entry that is on no page.

status.description: The status of the entry. A page body is always STANDING.

evidenceFor.description: For a CONSOLIDATED entry, the page whose body holds its fact.

distance.description: The vector distance from the query. Only present for a vector match.

relevanceScore.description: 1 minus the distance. Only present for a vector match.

allOf.description: HUMAN_VERIFIED: a person confirmed it. GROUNDED: accepted, and each citation holds. OBSERVED: accepted, and it rests on an outside page that the server read. PROVISIONAL: in use, but nothing confirms it yet. UNGROUNDED: all other entries.
allOf.title: KnowledgeTrustEnum

items.description: The evidence for an entry, and the result of the last check of it.

repo.description: CODE only. The full name of the repository.

path.description: CODE only. The path from the root of the repository.

commitSha.description: CODE only. The commit of the cited lines.

lines.description: CODE only. The cited lines at the last check, for example "40-52".

target.description: All kinds other than CODE. The issue key, the pull request URL, the comment id, the run id or the page URL.

judgment.description: CHANGED only. The decision of the judge model.

items.title: ServedCitation

lastCheckedAt.description: The latest check of a citation.

lastCheckedSha.description: The commit of the latest check of code.

items.title: KnowledgeSearchHit

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.
